concept: CIT-K zero-training exploration -> external regressors consume emergent (s,comfort) -> generalize
external_mlp: numpy MLP 3->16->16->1, ReLU+SGD, trained ONLY on CIT-K's autonomous (s,comfort) samples
trivial_baselines_same_train_set: constant / ridge-linear / kNN(k=5) trained on the SAME 80% train split (Kimi-K3 acceptance requirement)
interpretation: Any sufficiently flexible regressor can consume CIT-K's self-emerged experience stream and generalise beyond the cat's local memory (MLP 0.167, kNN 0.129, vs CIT-K lookup 0.286 MAE on unseen states). Deep learning is NOT specifically required here — trivial kNN matches or beats the small MLP; DL's expected advantage lies on high-dimensional perceptual inputs where kNN fails. The cooperation claim is therefore scoped to 'CIT-K's experience stream is consumable and generalisable', not 'CIT-K needs deep learning'. CIT-K itself stays zero-training/zero-NN throughout.
